Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
With the holding of the aPLOCalypse convention in Centre region, a National Qualifier for the French Championships will be held in Bailleu le Pin.

www.vekn.net/index.php/event-calendar/event/7044

Date: March 16th, 2013
Registration: 09h30-11h
Round1: 11:15
End of finals: 20:45

Food, drinks and coffee is available on site.

Opaque sleeves are requires, and a decklist is mandatory.
